method: Paired probes run serially in an isolated copy of current tracked/untracked source, with local workspace package links. Only listed reversions change the negative arm. TypeScript is rebuilt and all original bytes are restored between controls. Positive exit zero and behavioral negative exit one are required; compilation or setup failure is not a verdict. Original worktree files are never reverted. Each control records its own source snapshot and reversion-file hashes. After the legacy repair compatibility refinement, the two three-push controls and the new legacy recovery control are rerun; unchanged controls retain their original executed observations.
